texts.zh:
破解终端的过程中一个失效保护措施被触发了，这个房间瞬间被一种扩张性的泡沫状物质淹没。还没有人来得及帮上[Leader.GetName]，[Leader.GetHeShe][Leader.GetWasWere]就被完全包裹住了。多次尝试解救[Leader.GetHimHer]也毫无成效，这些材料一经移除又会快速自发归位。

我们按照标准流程拉动紧急锚链，取回了裂隙探球和已收集到的样本。
texts.en:
In the process of decoding the terminal, a failsafe was triggered and the entire room quickly filled with an expansive foam-like material. Before anyone could assist [Leader.GetName], [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetWasWere] completely encased. Any attempts to uncover [Leader.GetHimHer] were fruitless, as what material could be removed was instantly replaced.

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the emergency anchor and recovered the Rift Sphere and its collected samples.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]竟然从星界裂隙中回来了。

[Root.Leader.GetHeSheCap]……发生了一些变化。[Root.Leader.GetHisHer]似乎被囚禁在了这个时间线和其他时间线之间，年龄变得无法测量。

同样令人难以理解的是，[Root.Leader.GetHeShe]好像也获得了一些计算研究的天赋。
texts.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName] [Root.GetHasHave] unexpectedly returned from [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] journey inside one of the Astral Rifts.

[Root.Leader.GetHeSheCap] [Root.Leader.IsAre]... changed. Caught somewhere between this time and another, [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] age seems indeterminable.

Inexplicably, [Root.Leader.GetHeShe] also seemed to have gained an affinity for calculative research.
